notes.title: Coming soon! "Forgotlings"
notes.content:
Forgotlings is a breathtaking cinematic action-adventure set in an enchanted realm inhabited by lost things searching for a purpose. Journey to distant corners of our collective memories and unite warring tribes against a mysterious looming threat to their existence.
A wholly original story-world filled with wonder and imagination awaits your discovery.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/

“Unite All Things Lost”

Jump back into the mesmerizing Forgotten Lands and immerse yourself in a captivating adventure. Explore new parts of this enchanting realm, where mysteries abound and new discoveries await. Step into the shoes of Fig as you embark on a thrilling journey and experience the lives of intriguing Forgotlings. Get ready to fall in love with the charm and magic of the Forgotten Lands all over again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31720645/cf29728a30eca2e09331f442d515e934d64f9024.gif

Explore the Forgotten 
The player controls Fig, a gifted posing doll, who starts out a humble new spawn but eventually becomes the captain of the sentient ship Volare. Choose your destination in your quest to unite all things lost in this semi-open world metroidvania.
Thousands of hand-drawn animation frames and beautifully realized environments makes you feel as if you’re playing an animated movie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31720645/51497e797a38d1db7a58ca489fc1254fb591c8e0.gif
Fight Your Way
Bandits and critters lurk in the wilderness – combat in Forgotlings has a novel tie with the rest of the game’s design and lies somewhere between hack-n-slash and skill-based with a stealth aspect, presenting the player with several ways to go about confronting enemies. Fig’s arsenal of moves expands as the story progresses. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31720645/5529e5e65acffd5f73352129d04290974df7059c.gif
Connect with Forgotlings
Connect with forgotlings from various tribes through interactive conversation or challenge them to a game of INA – an original and deep ingame boardgame that is also a popular pastime in the world of forgotlings!
Full voice-acting bring characters and moments to life together with a beautifully haunting score featuring the renowned choir ensemble Theatre of Voices.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31720645/5b3db5c1ca30193d57220357fa14683dcb7606fb.gif

notes.title: Out Now - Language Patch and Free Playable Demo!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/acd7cdcc82d34c789625b0a9fe60c90be5bf1d68.gif

Forgotton Anne is now available with Russian, Portuguese, Portuguese-Brazilian, and Italian subtitles, and a free playable demo has just been released!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/d6079eff51e7b5c9c035772e8c4a5228f9881da6.jpg

The remaining languages - Polish and Spanish - will be rolled out in the coming weeks.

In addition to these languages, the patch features:

- Camera, Puzzle, and Platform Polish

- Multiple platforming behavior fixes

- and many minor polishes and bug fixes throughout the game

We hope you enjoy Forgotton Anne in your native tongue and if you haven’t played Forgotton Anne before, give the free demo a try. :)

As for our Japanese fans, we have a special treat planned for you later this year. Stay tuned!

We thank you from the bottom of our collective heart for your continued support.

notes.title: Forgotton Anne is out on Mac!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31720645/17dfb03457debcccfc7477545752960a0222a9e2.pngAs Forgotton Anne features traditional hand-drawn animations and oodles of visual art, many here at ThroughLine Games love working on Apple's Macintosh computers. It is for this reason we're stoked to announce that our labour of love, Forgotton Anne, can now be enjoyed on Mac through the Steam platform.

In addition to Mac Support, this update features:

- Updated camera logic

- Updated puzzle behaviour

- Increased platform visibility

- Multiple platorming fixes

- And many minor polishes throughout the game

We hope you enjoy Forgotton Anne on Mac and hope you'll take the time to tell your friends about it.
We thank you from the bottom of our collective heart for your continued support. :)
